testcase.name: Spacing: count = round-half-up(L / d) intervals (+1 for INCLUDE_END, at least 1 for EXCLUDE_END); the realised spacing is L / intervals; denser spacing on a longer spiral keeps the density
Spacing validation and explosion guard: non-positive, non-finite or tiny spacing is rejected before any sample is evaluated; countForSpacing saturates
Zero-length curves: equal-distance sampling falls back to the uniform parameters (all points coincide); spacing gives exactly one sample
Conical and planar spirals (radius changing, as for a spiral around a trident): consecutive samples are equally spaced in arc length within 2 tau (closed-form oracle)
Parameters are non-decreasing and within [t0, t1] for every policy and count, also for cusps, stationary points and adversarial curves
Monotone parameters under a loose tolerance (relative 2^-3) and dense sampling (60,000 samples), where the inversion's stopping tolerance exceeds the spacing
Quadratic Beziers: equal arc-length spacing within 2 tau (closed-form oracle), including extrapolated ranges
Constant-speed curves: equal-distance parameters equal the uniform parameters within 2 tau / speed; a closed circle sampled with EXCLUDE_END has no duplicate seam point
